notes: Mousin' Around Motor Bank Test (lower display 09) starting with the bank up (43 closed from emulator start). When the Motor Relay (11) energizes, the host opens 43, closes the bank-down switch 50 after 1.0 s of travel, waits for 11 to change, then opens 50 and closes 43 again after another 1.0 s; the run records whether and when the ROM releases 11 and what the lower display shows. The manual's Motor Bank Test says switch 43 tells the CPU that the motorized center target bank is up and switch 50 that it is down. The host answers the Motor Relay (11) only with fixed, scripted switch changes after the relay is observed energized; PinMAME's mechanics are off, so no switch moves on its own.

actions.label: observe the relay and display at the down position
observe the relay and display at the up position
